== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Reitzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Finals (4th)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star|ANH-D-deathstar.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH DeathStar Reitzel DS 1996 Worlds.txt |Download]]

Reitzel published this as the 60-card Dark deck he played at Vail. Titles normalized (Monnok, Boring Conversation Anyway, I Have You Now, Tatooine).

The Vermithrax transcription of the Scrye list for Reitzel has only 58 cards and differs from the list Reitzel published: it has 4 Alter, 3 Darth Vader, 3 Scanning Crew, 2 U-3PO, 2 Dantooine, Commander Praji and Gravity Shadow, and only 1 each of Charming To The Last, Kashyyyk and Vader's Lightsaber, with no Boring Conversation Anyway, Chief Bast, Dark Collaboration, General Tagge, Imperial Barrier or Presence Of The Force.<ref name="fb1996">Kevin Reitzel, Facebook post, 29 April 2026: [https://www.facebook.com/kevin.reitzel/posts/its-been-30-years-my-star-wars-ccg-1996-championship-deck-lists-that-i-used-at-t/10241711434940142/ "It's been 30 years…"] (his own 1996 Worlds lists, from the physical decks). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130834/https://swccg.com/snapshots/facebook/reitzel-1996-worlds-decklists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="verm">[https://vermsgameblog.blogspot.com/2013/04/star-wars-ccg-1996-dark-side-champion.html Star Wars CCG: 1996 Dark Side Champion Decklists], Vermithrax's Game Blog (7 April 2013; Scrye magazine transcription). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150729003158/http://vermsgameblog.blogspot.com/2013/04/star-wars-ccg-1996-dark-side-champion.html Internet Archive]</ref>
